blocks.text: Points P₁, P₃ aur P₅ par compression compression se aur rarefaction rarefaction se milta hai. Is liye superposition ke principle ke mutabiq yahan dono waves ke displacements jama ho jate hain aur CRO screen par bara resultant displacement nazar aata hai (Fig. 7.5-c).

blocks.title: Interesting Fact (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: White light mein sabun ki thin film (patli jhilli) par interference pattern banta hai; isi liye bulbulon par rang nazar aate hain.

blocks.alt: Kaale pas-manzar par handle wala gol taar ka chhalla, jis mein sabun ki patli jhilli (film): oopar safed aur halki pattiyan, phir narangi, laal aur jamni, phir neeli, peeli aur magenta ki bohat si patli leti dhaariyan, aur neeche surmai.
blocks.caption: White light mein sabun ki patli film se bana interference pattern (kitab ki chhapi tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par bare displacement wali wave (lehar) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(c): Constructive interference: CRO ki screen par bara displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par sirf pari axis par seedhi lakeer hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(d): Destructive interference: CRO ki screen par sifar displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P1, P3, P5 par microphone ke paas dono waves (lehrein) ek sath pahunchti hain, to CRO bari wave dikhata hai (Figure 7.5(c)). P2, P4 par ek ka compression doosre ke rarefaction se milta hai, to CRO par seedhi lakeer aati hai (Figure 7.5(d)).
Fig. 7.5 (b) se point P₁ par dono waves ka path difference (raaste ka farq) ΔS yeh hai:
Isi tarah points P₃ aur P₅ par path difference zero aur −λ hai. Yahan λ wavelength hai, yaani kinhi do consecutive solid ya dashed lines ka faasla.

blocks.title: Constructive interference
blocks.text: Jab bhi path difference wavelength ka poora multiple (integral multiple: 0, λ, 2λ, …) ho, to dono waves jama ho jati hain. Is effect (asar) ko constructive interference kehte hain.
